senses.gloss:
हेठ् हेठ् (according to some written हेट्),
cl. 1. A. P. हेठते, हेठति (according to
some हेटति), जिहेठे, हेठितुम्, to be wicked; to
vex, harass, obstruct; to strike, hurt, injure; cl. 9. P.
हेठ्नाति, &c. = rt. हेढ्: Caus. हेठयति, -यितुम्,
Aor. अजिहेठत्.

हेठ, अस्, m. vexation, harassing; hindering,
preventing, hindrance, obstruction, opposition; in-
jury, hurt.
